cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your dragon can stay for tea. Please keep the biscuit crumbs off my carpet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His three heads breathe fire. Should I take him outside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. He's fine here. Wait, three mouths? I need three napkins immediately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He brought his own. They're paper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paper? At my good table? Fetch the linen before the neighbors see.

mechanism: A corrects the hosting of a dragon with escalating alarm over napkin adequacy while remaining calm about its fire-breathing heads.
confusable: Ordinary hospitality is insufficient; D165 requires a visible contrast between calm impossibility and growing alarm at mundane detail.
comparison: A guest's table manners differ from protecting furniture during packing.
seedUse: Keep three mouths and paper napkins; make A correct actual table preparation instead of invoking unseen neighbors.
